content: Vitest 4.1.10 with Next.js: official Next.js guide covers vitest + @vitejs/plugin-react + jsdom + @testing-library/react 16.3.2 + vite-tsconfig-paths. Hard limitation: async Server Components are NOT supported by Vitest — React's RSC runtime is not available in the test env, so 'const data = await fetch()' inside a component throws on render. Pattern: extract data fetching into plain async functions and unit-test those; unit-test sync server components and all client components; cover async RSC and auth flows with Playwright E2E.
